verdict.rationale: GitCafe documents a public REST API with a reference page (docs/reference/api.md). The docs claim an OpenAPI 3.1 description for code generators and idempotent retries via `requestId`. Personal access tokens are scoped for scripts and tools to call the REST API, and `cafe api <path>` sends authenticated requests to any endpoint. The probe's 404s on guessed OpenAPI paths only show the spec isn't at standard well-known locations; they don't contradict the documented API. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the API works as documented, and a verified, discoverable location for the OpenAPI spec.
